title: The 11 links that explain today's biggest late winners: Tucows +27.9%,OneWater +17.4%, Energizer +13.8%. Which of these moves has legs?
author: tickeron_community
selftext:
The afternoon belonged to deals and earnings beats. Tucows jumped  
27.9% on a fiber sale to a GTCR- and Berkshire Partners-backed buyer,  
OneWater rose 17.4% on an EPS beat, and Energizer hit a 52-week high,  
up 13.8% after earnings. Which of these moves has legs?  
  
Here is the rundown, drawn from today's write-ups.  
  
\*\*1. Tucows (TCX)\*\* — Tucows shares jumped +27.86% to $14.64, up $3.19  
from Monday's $11.45 close, during regular Nasdaq trading after  
gapping higher in premarket. The catalyst: Ting Fiber agreed to sell  
Ting Holdco's owned fiber markets to Clearwave, backed by GTCR and  
Berkshire Partners, for nominal cash while removing about $301.5  
million of securitized fiber notes from the balance sheet.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-tucows-inc-tcx-stock-up-27-86-today-39905/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-tucows-inc-tcx-stock-up-27-86-today-39905/)  
  
\*\*2. OneWater Marine (ONEW)\*\* — ONEW jumped from a $9.10 prior close  
to $10.68, up +17.36%, in Tuesday's regular session, with gains  
front-loaded in the first half hour after the open. The catalyst was  
fiscal Q4 results released before the bell: adjusted EPS of $0.13  
versus roughly $0.05–$0.08 expected, a GAAP swing to $0.5M net income  
from a $113M loss, gross margin up 60 bps to 23.2%, and FY27 adjusted  
EBITDA guided to $80–95M.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-onewater-marine-onew-stock-up-17-36-today-39910/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-onewater-marine-onew-stock-up-17-36-today-39910/)  
  
\*\*3. SharonAI (SHAZ)\*\* — SHAZ jumped +16.00%, climbing from Monday's  
close of $20.13 to $23.35, with the gain occurring during Tuesday's  
regular session after recovering from a premarket low of $18.50. The  
advance was a rebound from deeply oversold levels following Monday's  
\~17% post-earnings collapse, which was triggered by Q3 revenue of  
$9.93 million badly missing the \~$26.94 million consensus.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-sharonai-holdings-shaz-stock-up-16-79-today-39915/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-sharonai-holdings-shaz-stock-up-16-79-today-39915/)  
  
\*\*4. Energizer (ENR)\*\* — Energizer Holdings (ENR) jumped +13.76% to  
$27.69 from the previous close of $24.34, with the advance building  
during Tuesday's regular session and carrying shares to a new 52-week  
high. The catalyst was fiscal fourth-quarter results published before  
the open: adjusted EPS of $1.37 beat the $1.31 consensus, adjusted  
gross margin expanded +400 bps to 42.5%, adjusted EBITDA rose +13%,  
and management guided...  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-energizer-holdings-enr-stock-up-13-27-today-39924/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-energizer-holdings-enr-stock-up-13-27-today-39924/)  
  
\*\*5. Smith-Midland (SMID)\*\* — Smith-Midland (SMID) stock jumped  
\+11.46%, climbing from Monday's close of $20.25 to $22.57 by  
mid-afternoon, with the move occurring during the regular session. The  
catalyst was third-quarter results issued after Monday's close:  
revenue up +6% to $22.8 million, gross margin expanding 300 basis  
points to 29.8%, EPS of $0.56 and record backlog of $72.4 million, up  
\+32% year-over-year.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-smith-midland-corporation-smid-stock-up-11-46-today-39948/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-smith-midland-corporation-smid-stock-up-11-46-today-39948/)  
  
\*\*6. PrimeEnergy Resources (PNRG)\*\* — PNRG jumped +10.23% to $208.07  
from a $188.76 prior close, gapping to $201.49 at the open and  
extending gains through regular-hours trading. The catalyst was the  
Nov. 16 third-quarter report: EPS of $4.61 beat the $2.91 consensus by  
$1.70, revenue of $45.3M topped the $44.6M estimate, and liquidity  
totaled $145.8M with no bank debt.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-primeenergy-resources-corporation-pnrg-stock-up-10-23-today-39946/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-primeenergy-resources-corporation-pnrg-stock-up-10-23-today-39946/)  
  
\*\*7. LuxExperience B.V. (LUXE)\*\* — LUXE jumped from a $10.75 previous  
close to $11.72, a gain of +9.02%, with the move occurring during  
Tuesday's regular session on the NYSE. The catalyst was the Q1 FY27  
report released before the open: net sales rose +9.6% (+8.5% ex-FX),  
revenue of €614.1M beat consensus, adjusted EBITDA improved in all  
three segments, and FY27 guidance was raised to 6–9% sales growth and  
a 2.5–3.5% adjusted EBITDA margin.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-luxexperience-b-v-luxe-stock-up-9-02-today-39945/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-luxexperience-b-v-luxe-stock-up-9-02-today-39945/)  
  
\*\*8. MINISO Group Holding (MNSO)\*\* — MNSO jumped +8.54%, climbing from  
the prior close of $11.24 to $12.20 during Tuesday's regular session,  
extending a premarket gain of roughly +5.87%. The catalyst was the  
premarket release of September-quarter results: non-GAAP EPADS of  
$0.35 beat estimates by $0.03, and revenue of $988.2M rose +14.3% year  
over year, topping consensus by about $18.5M.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-miniso-group-holding-limited-mnso-stock-up-8-63-today-39955/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-miniso-group-holding-limited-mnso-stock-up-8-63-today-39955/)  
  
\*\*9. United Natural Foods (UNFI)\*\* — UNFI jumped to $52.43, up +$4.04,  
or +8.35%, from Monday's close of $48.39, with the gain occurring  
during regular-market hours. Goldman Sachs upgraded UNFI to Buy from  
Neutral and raised its target to $60 from $49, citing EBITDA growth  
runway, outsized natural and organic exposure, network-optimization  
gains and a food-at-home inflation tailwind.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-united-natural-foods-unfi-stock-up-8-25-today-39963/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-united-natural-foods-unfi-stock-up-8-25-today-39963/)  
  
\*\*10. Elbit Systems (ESLT)\*\* — ESLT jumped +6.47% in Tuesday's regular  
session, rising from Monday's close of $680.74 to $724.75 — a gain of  
\+$44.01. Elbit reported third-quarter 2026 results before the open:  
revenue climbed +17.2% to $2.25 billion, GAAP diluted EPS rose +32% to  
$3.70 and non-GAAP EPS to $4.36, ahead of consensus, alongside a  
record $33.0 billion order backlog and guidance for high-teens 2027  
revenue growth.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-elbit-systems-ltd-eslt-stock-up-6-33-today-39978/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-elbit-systems-ltd-eslt-stock-up-6-33-today-39978/)  
  
\*\*11. Seabridge Gold (SA)\*\* — SA jumped +6.78% to $26.16 during  
regular trading, up from Monday's close of $24.50, recovering part of  
a week-long slide that had left shares just above their 52-week low of  
$23.26. The driver was sector-wide: gold miners rallied across the  
board as bullion rebounded from a more-than-one-year low near  
$3,830/oz, and SA's high leverage to the metal amplified the bounce.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-seabridge-gold-inc-sa-stock-up-6-78-today-39971/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-seabridge-gold-inc-sa-stock-up-6-78-today-39971/)  
  
Which of these moves has legs?  
  
Not financial advice. Figures are from today's (Nov 17) write-ups,  
using intraday or latest-close prices, not live quotes. Price targets  
are targets, not promises.
